# computed-value

```python
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder as Encoder
输出配置 = {
    'handle_unknown': 'ignore',
    "sparse" : len(columns) > 64,  # sparse threshold
}
encoder = Encoder(**输出配置)
```
